pages.title: The village square
paragraphs: Across the water from your farm, the old village square has fallen into ruin. Rowing over is easy: tap the signpost or the little boat on your farm's east beach, or open Village and tap Go.
The square has six lots, one for each room of the old village. A room is rebuilt when you have filled all of its bundles. You can rebuild them in any order, whenever you like.

Tap a lot or the board in front of it to see what it needs. Rooms open at a level: the Pantry at 10, the Barn Room at 15, the Treasury at 32. The Pier, the Kitchen and the Workshop open in a later update.

pages.title: Bundles
paragraphs: A bundle is a short shopping list: a few kinds of crops, animal goods, or coins. Give what you have, and the bundle keeps it. Nothing is ever lost, and you can finish a bundle over several days.
Short of something? Tap Ask beside it and your friends can send it to you. Villagers like to see their rooms rebuilt: every bundle you fill brings you closer to the villager who owns it.
Watch the square change as you give. A ruin turns to bare ground, then a frame goes up, and when the last bundle is full the room is rebuilt with a little celebration and a letter from the villager.

pages.title: What rebuilt rooms give
paragraphs: The Pantry: Rosa sells rare seeds at her stall in the square, a few every day. Switch them on in the seed tray when you plant, and the harvest has a much better chance of being silver or gold.
The Barn Room: all your animals make their products 10% sooner, for good.
The Treasury: delivery trucks always pay 15% more, and every Saturday is village market day: your orders and your roadside stall pay 10% more. Look for the basket on the Calendar.
